what: On first open, a few logo and mark images flicker in turn at screen center — the first one .5s (0→40% on, holds until 80%, off at 100%), then each following one .4s (30% · 70%) in sequence. Meanwhile at 1.5s a dark veil 30% wider than the screen (its left 20% a gradient from transparent to dark) sweeps out to the right over .75s, narrowing to 30% width and fading (curve ease) — the page is revealed starting from the left where the veil clears. Fires fx:done at the end

options.sweep: When the curtain starts sweeping away (seconds), default 1.5 — 0 is immediate
options.dur: Length (seconds) of the curtain sweeping out, default .75 — 0 lifts it immediately
options.--fx-veil: Curtain color (CSS variable), default var(--kf-contrast-bg) — the original is a dark night brown

note: The original does not wait for window load and runs on CSS timing (this version removes js-preload after load to open the transition). The blocker covers the screen but has no pointer-events, so you can still click what is underneath

from.where: index.html .sk-loader (original .js-loader: ::before linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgb(47,26,25) 20%) animation roll .75s 1.5s forwards, img01 load_first .5s · img02~04 load .4s delay .5 · .9 · 1.3s)
